field.name: Name
analysers.title: Analysers
analysers.subtitle: Connected instruments, their link to the site agent and the flags that hold results.
analysers.flagsHint: Flags marked Stop hold the result in auto-verification; Record only records the flag.
analysers.codeHint: Up to 16 letters, digits, - or _. Cannot change later.
analysers.serialHint: Baud, parity, data bits, stop bits — e.g. 9600,n,8,1
analysers.roleHint: The agent takes the opposite role of the instrument.
analysers.connectionHint: The state the site agent last reported; the cloud never connects to the instrument itself.
analysers.confirm.activate: Activate analyser {code}? Its agent will relay its results again.
analysers.confirm.deactivate: Deactivate analyser {code}? Incoming results will be refused until it is activated again.
mapping.title: Analyser tests
mapping.subtitle: Map the instrument codes to tests. Only codes with Auto Send land results.
mapping.empty: No tests mapped on this analyser
mapping.chooseHint: Choose the analyser whose codes you want to map.
mapping.findTestHint: Type at least two letters of the code or name.
mapping.hostCodeHint: The code the instrument expects in order queries, when different.
mapping.resultSelectionHint: Which value to take when a message carries several.
mapping.autoSendRule: Auto Send is the permission to save incoming results: a mapping without it never lands a result.
mapping.autoSendOffMessage: Results for code {code} will no longer land. Continue?
mapping.invalidNumbers: Slope and intercept must be numbers; the slope cannot be zero.
mapping.confirm.deactivate: Deactivate the mapping of {code}? Its results will be logged as unmapped.
conversions.title: Conversion table
conversions.hint: A source value is exact text or a comparison on the number (<10, <=10, >50, >=50). The first matching row wins.
conversions.empty: No conversions: values pass through unchanged.
range.title: Analyser-specific range
range.order: The low bound cannot exceed the high bound.
codeSheet.title: Analyser code sheet
samples.title: Analyser samples
samples.subtitle: The instrument code of each sample type; some instruments refuse an order without it.
samples.chooseHint: Choose the analyser whose sample codes you want to edit.
samples.empty: No sample codes on this analyser
agents.title: Site agents
agents.subtitle: The connector of each branch: status, heartbeat, logs and its credential.
agents.createHint: The client id and secret are shown once after creation; enter them in the agent installed at the branch.
agents.pushed: Configuration pushed to {name}; the agent reloads at its next heartbeat.
agents.confirmRotate: Issue a new secret for {name}? The current secret stops working at once and the agent must be updated.
agents.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate {name}? Its credential is revoked and its sessions end.
agents.confirmReactivate: Reactivate {name}? A new client id and secret are issued.
agents.configHint: Agent-local settings as a JSON object (max 16 KB). Saving a change increases the configuration version.
agents.configInvalid: The configuration must be a JSON object.
agents.noAnalysers: No analyser is hosted by this agent. Choose the agent in the analyser editor.
secret.title: Client credentials — shown once
secret.warning: Copy the secret now. It is not stored in clear and cannot be shown again; rotate it if it is lost.
secret.hint: The agent exchanges these for short-lived tokens at /api/v1/auth/token.
secret.copyFailed: Copy failed; select the text and copy it by hand.
secret.acknowledge: I have stored the secret safely
logs.empty: No log entries for these filters
logs.hint: A healthy result shows StartSend then Passed Check per sample ID; an Exception line names the cause.
intake.empty: No results received for these filters
kits.title: PCR kits
kits.subtitle: Interpretation of each kit on each instrument: thresholds, verdict rules and folders.
kits.nameHint: The agent names the kit of a run file by it, e.g. Biorad_Solgent.
kits.testCodeHint: The mapping the verdict lands through (its Auto Send and conversions apply).
kits.serialLockHint: Files from any other instrument are refused.
kits.valueColumnHint: The Ct column: Cq on BioRad, CT on QuantStudio.
kits.patientContentHint: e.g. Unkn — other rows (controls) are skipped.
kits.noAmplificationHint: Comma-separated, e.g. N/A, Undetermined (blank and 0 always count).
kits.genesHint: A low Ct is positive: Ct ≤ positive max is positive, up to the borderline max is borderline, above it or no value is negative.
kits.rulesHint: Enough positive targets → DETECTED; fewer, or any borderline → Presumptive; no target with the internal control → NOT DETECTED; nothing at all → INVALID.
kits.thresholdsInvalid: Every threshold must be a number.
kits.confirm.deactivate: Deactivate kit {name}? Its run files will be moved to the failed folder.
kits.pasteHint: Paste the run file as delimited text (export the sheet as CSV).
kits.failedFile: The file would go to the failed folder:
kits.readFile: Read {count} sample(s) from instrument {serial}; the file would go to the backup folder.
